questions.q: Completa: I'm sixteen and I'm the ___ child in my family.

task: Describe una foto de tu familia o de tus amigos en 5 frases: quién es quién, cómo son y dónde están.
paragraphs: This is a photo of my family. It's my grandmother's birthday and we are in her garden.
The woman in the middle is my grandmother, Rose. She is eighty years old today! Next to her is my grandfather, Peter. He has white hair and glasses.
The tall man on the left is my father, and the woman with long black hair is my mother. My parents are doctors. The boy with the dog is my brother, Jack. He is twelve. The dog's name is Biscuit.
Where am I? I'm not in the photo, because I have the camera! I'm sixteen and I'm the oldest child in my family.
